summary: DNR two-story live-in cab at Salmon River, Grays Harbor County, from 1967. Moved in 2000 to the Foothills Historical Museum in Buckley, which posts public hours.

facts.status_note: Cab moved in 2000 to the Buckley museum, most likely the Foothills Historical Museum. No source read describes the original site today.

staffing.status: 1969 newspaper said the Salmon River Ridge station would be manned; no later staffing record found

access.note: The Buckley museum, most likely the Foothills Historical Museum, is open at posted hours with admission by donation. No source says the cab is on display or open to climb.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firetower.org and firelookout.com give 1965 for the platform and trailer and 1967 for the cab. Rex's page quotes a DNR report giving 1966-68 for the tower's erection. The story uses the 1965 and 1967 dates and gives the DNR range.
Firetower.org and firelookout.com say Buckley Museum; WillhiteWeb says Buckley Foothills Museum; the museum's contact page says Foothills Historical Museum. The story uses the museum's own name.

notes_for_editor: The brief's museum name, Buckley Foothills Museum, is WillhiteWeb's wording. The museum's own page says Foothills Historical Museum. No source names that museum as the cab's home. Linking the 'Buckley Museum' to it is an inference from name and town, and the story says so. Museum hours come from an undated contact page and may be out of date. Not verified: whether the cab is displayed, indoors or out, and its condition. The firetower.org page has a 1984 photo already in the FFLOS record, so no photo was added. Lake Quinault location is from firelookout.com. WillhiteWeb's relocated list also has a separate entry, 'Salmon Ridge Lookout - moved to Buckley Foothills Museum'; this check did not establish whether it is the same tower as Salmon River.
